summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, reporting a newspaper advertisement for its 42nd Annual General Meeting (AGM) to be held via video conference, including record date and final dividend information. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure required under Indian stock exchange regulations, serving as an AGM notice equivalent to a proxy statement filing. No special-situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or management change is indicated; the filing merely updates shareholders on meeting logistics and dividend details. There are no deal terms, advisor appointments, or structural changes involved.
